The FloPlast 110mm push-fit 3-boss single socket pipe, constructed from durable uPVC, is an essential component for soil and vent drainage systems. This grey pipe facilitates robust connections within various plumbing installations, ideal for plumbers and builders. It accommodates three waste pipes via boss adaptors, suitable for 32, 40, and 50mm waste pipe connections. The innovative push-fit system features reliable ring seal joints, allowing for swift and secure installation without solvent welding, ensuring a watertight and efficient drainage solution.
